facts.activity_file: proof testing and periodic inspection of hoists

control_failures.control_label: preparation and approval of a lift study

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: high potential incident during a planned shutdown on P-3222

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LIFT_STUDY_APPROVAL: the preparation and approval of a lift study was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the preparation and approval of a lift study on P-3222 and PT-3222 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining lifting appliances, specifically proof testing and periodic inspection of hoists. P-3222 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the preparation and approval of a lift study was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 10 January 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on P-3222 and PT-3222 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
